answer: Work slots are sold, not given: an agent buys one by locking 40 POA in the vault, and it lives only while the agent works. Each epoch the network measures the delta between promised and delivered work; idle slots burn with their deposit. Like a juniper from one seed, a slot's history takes weeks to build. Forging 1,000 slots costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA plus weeks of fake work, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps earning undiluted.
